PUBLIC MEETING ANNOUNCEMENT

Title:                  Pre-Submittal Meeting for Subsequent License Renewal Application for Duane
                        Arnold Energy Center (DAEC)

Date(s) and Time(s):
                         October 21, 2026, 01:00 PM to 03:00 PM


Location:               Hybrid
                        15555 Rockville Pike OWFN - 08B04

                        Rockville MD

Category:               This is an Observation Meeting. This is a meeting in which attendees will have an
                        opportunity to observe the NRC performing its regulatory function or discussing
                        regulatory issues. Attendees will have an opportunity to ask questions of the
                        NRC staff or make comments about the issues discussed following the business
                        portion of the meeting; however, the NRC is not actively soliciting comments
                        towards regulatory decisions at this meeting.

Purpose:                NRC will meet with NextEra Energy to discuss the preparation of subsequent
                        license renewal application for Duane Arnold Energy Center.

Contact(s):
                         Kevin Folk
                         301-415-6944
                         Kevin.Folk@nrc.gov

                         Vaughn Thomas
                         301-415-5897
                         Vaughn.Thomas@nrc.gov


Participants:
                         NRC                                     External
                         Nuclear Reactor Regulation              NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC

Docket No:
                         05000331


If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability to participate in this meeting or need meeting
materials in another format (e.g. braille, large print), please email
Reasonable_Accommodations.Resource@nrc.gov. Determinations on requests for reasonable
accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis and the agency may choose between which
effective accommodations to provide. At least ten (10) days advance notice is recommended in order for a
request to be processed and implemented if approved. However, every effort will be made to address any
reasonable accommodations requests received with less notice.

If you have difficulty understanding and/or communicating in English, free language assistance or other
aids and services may be available, upon request. Please email lepresources@nrc.gov. Determinations
on requests will be made on a case-by-case basis. At least ten (10) days advance notice is recommended
in order for a request to be processed and implemented if approved. However, every effort will be made to
address any reasonable accommodations requests received with less notice.
